name: 薇丝拉
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_四_魔族之世.md:169
who: Vesla, a demon-kin woman, a dyer's daughter from the lower city of White Crown city, thirty-five: tall, about 176 cm, slender and straight-backed. A pair of jet-black horns sweeping back from the hairline, curved like two scimitars sheathed; she gathers her blue-black hair behind the horns with a strip of blue cloth. Her eyes are two colours, one amber and one grey-blue, and she does not blink when she looks at people. A long face, a pointed jaw, thin lips that do not smile. Both hands blue to the wrists from twenty years of dyeing and no longer washable. A carved wooden tag hangs openly at her throat. A firm, silent, relentless air.
build: 176 cm, tall, slender and straight-backed: a C-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips; she can walk all day without riding.
palette: indigo blue and jet black, amber and grey-blue, undyed linen, a little iron
casual: Her dyer's clothes: a long indigo-blue cotton smock with the sleeves rolled up, her blue hands showing, the carved wooden tag in plain view at her throat on a cord, a driver's long whip coiled in her right hand, a thick ledger of names tied at her belt, sturdy boots. She does not smile.
private: Home clothes: a soft undyed linen long-sleeved dress with a grey shawl, the horns bare, the hair loose, felt shoes. She stands holding the open ledger against her chest, her blue fingers resting on a line of names, a tired, quiet look.
battle: Dressed to lead a column: the blue smock belted tight, a dark travelling cloak with the hood down, leather bracers, sturdy boots, the ledger at her belt. She holds the long driver's whip beside her, the lash curling toward the ground.
formal: A clean dark indigo wool dress with long sleeves and a soft draped neck, dyed in the shop she grew up in, the carved wooden tag worn outside on the breast on its cord, the horns bare with the blue band holding the hair, the ledger of names held to her chest in both arms, its cover ink faintly glowing. She stands very straight, a stern, dignified look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly so the amber eye and the grey-blue eye are both clear, looking steadily and without blinking at the viewer, a closed mouth. Cold blue dusk light from one side and a warm lantern glow from the other. Foreground blur: the coil of a driver's whip and a page of tiny written names. She wears the indigo smock and the wooden tag.

name: 尤里安
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_四_魔族之世.md:225
who: Julian, a demon-kin carpenter of the lower city of White Crown city, twenty-five: medium height, about 178 cm, broad and sturdy. An honest round face with a thin pale scar across the nose from a plane shaving. Messy flax-coloured hair with wood shavings always caught in it. Olive-green eyes that look first at the joints of things. The backs of both hands are covered in a fine layer of blue-grey scales that feel cool to touch; the palms are all callus from planing. A carved wooden tag hangs at his throat, polished with tung oil. A kind, handy, steady and patient air.
build: 178 cm, broad and sturdy: thick shoulders and forearms, big capable hands; he can carry a cart axle for a mile and repair a wheel all night.
palette: flax and fresh pine yellow, olive green, blue-grey scale, plain brown
casual: His carpenter's clothes: a coarse brown linen short smock with the sleeves rolled, a leather tool belt with a plane, a chisel and a small saw hanging from it, the tung-oiled wooden tag shining at his throat, sturdy boots. He holds a plane against his chest, a shy, warm smile.
private: Off-duty clothes: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain trousers, soft shoes. He stands holding a small carved wooden bird in one hand, a sleepy, contented smile.
battle: Dressed for the road with the column: the smock belted, a leather apron, thick leather gloves over the scaled hands, the tool belt still on. He grips a heavy wooden mallet in both hands, held across the body.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing braced and protective, the feet planted, both hands gripping a heavy wooden mallet across the body; a worried but firm look, the mouth closed.
formal: A clean brown wool coat with wooden buttons over a white linen shirt, the tag outside on his breast, the hair combed down, a small carved box in his hands. He stands up straight, a shy, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the olive-green eyes looking at the viewer with a warm, gentle look, a small shy smile. Warm amber light from one side and cool blue light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting wood shavings and the edge of a plane near the lens. He wears the brown smock and the polished tag.

name: 奈拉
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_四_魔族之世.md:281
who: Nyra, a demon-kin priestess of the White Candle infirmary of White Crown city, twenty-eight: slim and not tall, about 162 cm. A pair of curved pale grey horns, but the horn on her left (on the viewer's right when they face us) is only half there, its broken end worn smooth and round. Short black hair cut to show her ears and horn roots. Very deep violet eyes with a soft look. The backs of her hands are marked all over with old burns and the lines of bandages, wax stains on her fingertips. A carved wooden tag hangs at her throat with a small stub of burnt white candle beside it. A gentle, tired, steady and unfussy air.
build: 162 cm, slim and light: a B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips; she can carry a wounded man half a mile on her back.
palette: candle white and pale grey, deep violet, blood-spotted linen, a little wax yellow
casual: Her infirmary clothes: a long white linen robe with the hem spattered with blood spots that never wash out, the sleeves bound back, a cloth bag at her belt with bandages, herbs and a bundle of white candles; the wooden tag and the burnt candle stub at her throat. She holds a white candle in her hand, a soft, tired look.
private: Home clothes: a soft long-sleeved grey wool dress with a knitted shawl, the bandages off, felt shoes. She stands holding a mug of warm milk in both hands, a quiet, sleepy smile.
battle: Dressed to tend the wounded on a march: the white robe belted tight with the skirt tied up, a dark travelling cloak with the hood down, the bandage bag at her belt, sturdy shoes. A lit white candle in her left hand, a roll of bandage in her right.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, a healer standing braced, the feet planted, one hand holding up a lit white candle and the other a roll of bandage; a calm, fierce look of concentration, the mouth closed.
formal: A clean long white linen robe with long sleeves and a plain round neck, a narrow gold edge at the cuffs, a white sash, the tag laid outside the neckline, a lit white candle held before her in both hands, its flame warm and unwavering. She stands very still, a solemn, gentle look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the deep violet eyes looking softly at the viewer, a faint kind closed-mouth smile. The warm glow of one white candle held near her chin lights her face from below, cool blue night light from the other side. Foreground blur: the candle flame and drifting wisps of smoke. She wears the white robe and the tag with the candle stub.

name: 塞克斯图斯
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_四_魔族之世.md:337
who: Sextus, a human centurion of the eastern legion's expulsion squads, forty-five: tall, about 183 cm, lean and a little stooped. A long face with deep lines. Short grey-white hair; the top of his left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us) is missing a chunk, bitten off by a wolf when he was young. Light green eyes that always look at a person's shoulder and not at the face. A stern, tired, dutiful air, a man who does not enjoy his orders.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's long face of about forty-five, deep lines at the brow and the mouth, hollow cheeks, light green eyes with a tired steady look, thin grey eyebrows, a straight nose. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 183 cm, lean and a little stooped: long limbs, a wiry frame, hard from walking for years.
palette: legion grey-blue and iron, light green, bone, worn leather brown
casual: His off-duty centurion's clothes: the grey-blue legion cloak with the ring-of-fire and crossed-keys emblem on the chest worn white, over a plain grey wool tunic and trousers, old boots; a water flask at his belt one size larger than the others. A tired look, glancing away.
private: Off-duty clothes: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain trousers, old soft boots, no cloak. He stands with the big flask in one hand, a weary, wry half-smile.
battle: On duty: an old worn legion cuirass over the grey tunic, bone-silver rune-lines worn almost dull along its plates, the grey-blue cloak with the white-worn emblem on the chest, a plain open helm, a short legion sword drawn in his right hand and held low; the large water flask at his belt.
formal: The grey-blue cloak brushed and pinned, a clean grey tunic with a plain belt, the worn emblem on the chest, the short sword sheathed. He stands at attention with his hands behind him, a grim, dutiful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly with the eyes looking just past the viewer, a faint tired closed-mouth expression. Cold grey dawn light from one side and the dying orange of a campfire from the other. Foreground blur: drifting ash and the edge of a water flask. He wears the grey-blue cloak with the worn emblem.

name: 提诺
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_四_魔族之世.md:522
who: Tino, a demon-kin boy of seven, the son of a weaver in the lower city of White Crown city: small, about 118 cm, thin. A pair of tiny jet-black horns on his forehead. Gold-brown eyes that do not blink when he looks at a lamp. Short dark brown hair, untidy. A thin pale-gold scar crosses his left palm (on the viewer's right when they face us). He wears a small carved wooden tag at his neck, tucked under his collar. A quiet, grave, watchful child's air; he does not cry and says little, and he hides his left hand behind his back.
palette: warm brown and gold-brown, undyed wool, jet black, a faint pale gold
casual: His everyday clothes: a plain undyed wool tunic to the knees with long sleeves, brown wool leggings, small patched shoes, a thick grey scarf; the carved wooden tag tucked under the collar. He stands with his left hand hidden behind his back and a small hand-woven shawl held against himself, a serious, quiet look.
private: Home clothes: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt to the knees, wool leggings and warm socks, a small blanket round his shoulders. He stands holding a small unlit lamp in both hands, a sleepy, quiet look.
battle: Dressed for the long road: the wool tunic belted with a cord, a hooded brown cloak, wool leggings, sturdy small boots, a small bundle on his back, a short walking stick in one hand.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, a small boy standing braced for a long walk, the feet planted, one hand gripping a short walking stick and the other hidden behind his back; a serious, determined look, the mouth closed.
formal: A clean small dark brown wool coat with wooden buttons over a white linen shirt, long trousers, polished small shoes, the hair combed flat. He stands up straight with his hands folded in front, a grave, quiet look.
art: A close head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the gold-brown eyes looking at the viewer without blinking, the mouth closed. Warm lamplight from one side and cool grey light from the other. Foreground blur: the glow of a small lamp near the lens. He wears the wool tunic and the grey scarf.
